svg.title: D03a | Polymorphic roles and policy interfaces

g.text: D03a | Polymorphic roles and policy interfaces
calculate(raw : MarkUnits, maximum : MarkUnits, elapsed : TimePoint) : MarkUnits
calculate(raw : MarkUnits, maximum : MarkUnits, elapsed : TimePoint) : MarkUnits
Id, TimePoint and MarkUnits are int64_t aliases,
not distinct wrapper classes. Roles use enum class Role.
makeUser returns unique_ptr<User>; authorization calls role().
